messages:
incident-bot: PAGER: P1 - Dedicated pool (medcare-dedicated-12) high error rate + suspected cross-tenant embedding leakage. Pager routed to oncall-maya at 04:14 UTC.

oncall-maya: I'm on it. @sre-kyle please pull 1m/5m p99 for embedding_lookup and error logs for pool-12. Isolating traffic in progress?

sre-kyle: pulling metrics. p99 embedding_lookup went from 90ms -> 1.9s starting 04:08 UTC, error rate jumped to 6%. Saw multiple responses where embedding payloads contained tokens referencing tenant id magenta-9 inside medcare responses. :grimacing: grabbing sample responses now.

eng-runtime-zoe: that's worrying. Last runtime sidecar rollout included env changes for EMB_CACHE_NAMESPACE. I'm checking rollout history on pool-12.

eng-platform-chen: I'm patching the LB to shift medcare traffic off pool-12 to spare nodes and will cordon the nodes hosting pool-12 pods. Doing a quick scale-up of fallback dedicated nodes.

oncall-maya: do that. Also put medcare on emergency rate-limiting 2rps per API key pending investigation. cs-liz, please prepare an immediate-but-brief customer note.

cs-liz: drafting now: "We've detected elevated latency and are investigating a potential data overlap between tenants in your dedicated cluster. We're isolating traffic and will follow up with details." Sending to legal and security for review before sending.

eng-runtime-zoe: confirmed: a sidecar envvar misconfiguration was rolled out to pool-12 at 03:55 UTC. EMB_CACHE_NAMESPACE was inadvertently unset for a subset of sidecar replicas during a canary, which causes the sidecar to default to a global cache namespace. That explains cross-tenant key collisions for the embedding cache layer.

sre-kyle: logs corroborate that: several embedding fetches resolved from cache key "emb:global:..." instead of "emb:tenant:medcare:...". Two request payloads included short snippets that matched other tenant metadata. Uploading redacted artifacts to secure bucket s3://inc-evidence/1806001234/

eng-security: treat as potential data exposure. Start secure evidence chain and legal hold. @legal-marta standby to coordinate wording for customer and regulatory obligations.

eng-platform-chen: traffic shift complete. medcare requests now hitting medcare-fallback-2 and medcare-fallback-3. p99 back to ~110ms on fallback. We're continuing to drain pool-12 nodes but preserving node snapshots for forensics.

oncall-maya: next steps: 1) lock and snapshot current sidecar images and env, 2) rollback sidecar to pre-change image or explicitly set EMB_CACHE_NAMESPACE=tenant-${TENANT_ID} for all replicas, 3) disable cache namespace fallback to global as emergency toggle, 4) prepare customer call.

eng-runtime-zoe: rolling a config patch to explicitly set EMB_CACHE_NAMESPACE on all sidecars to tenant scope. Will apply via configmap update and restart watchers. Also preparing a strict hotfix to make the sidecar fail closed if namespace is unset (fail fast).

sre-kyle: executing emergency toggle: feature flag emb.cache.allow_global=false applied. That should prevent any new global cache hits. Propagation across clusters in ~20s.

eng-platform-chen: restarting the 6 sidecar replicas on pool-12 with corrected env. We'll not delete pods to preserve memory images until snapshot taken. Snapshot job queued: gcloud compute instances snapshot medcare-node-7 --snapshot-names inc-1806001234-node7

cs-liz: legal-marta has reviewed the customer draft and suggested softer wording around exposure. Sent revised note at 04:35 UTC: "We detected elevated latency and a potential cache isolation issue; we've isolated your traffic and are conducting a forensic review. We'll follow up with a technical timeline and remediation plan within 48 hours." medcare security replied: "Please confirm whether any PHI is affected. We need a call asap"

legal-marta: we need to be cautious. Don't include any sample data in outbound messages. Offer a private joint forensics session and commit to redacted findings. Also start preparing any notification obligations under HIPAA while we confirm scope.

ceo-james: please keep me posted. If PHI is involved we need an executive call within 6 hours and a remediation/credit proposal.

finance-raj: quick note on credits: proposed preliminary credit for a month of equivalent dedicated pool costs = $60,000. Approve provisional hold pending final signoff.

eng-platform-chen: sidecar envfix rollout completed at 04:46 UTC. Restarted replicas show EMB_CACHE_NAMESPACE=tenant-${TENANT_ID}. Embedding cache hits for global namespace dropped to zero.

sre-kyle: sampling post-fix responses—no new cross-tenant artifacts in the 30m sample window. Observability shows p99 back to expected on fallback nodes and controlled for medcare traffic.

eng-security: forensics checklist: obtain sidecar container images, configmaps, deployment manifests, pod env dumps, cache key dumps, and all candidate response artifacts. Preserve chain-of-custody. We'll redact PHI and work with medcare legal before sharing details.

eng-runtime-zoe: root-cause initial note for RCA: "A canary-stage rollout inadvertently left EMB_CACHE_NAMESPACE unset in a subset of sidecar replicas. The sidecar's cache fallback behavior defaulted to a global namespace, causing cache key collisions across tenants. Contributing factors: rollout gating focused on perf signals, no validation for required namespace env, and insufficient integration tests covering cache namespace loss modes."

oncall-maya: OK team - compile an internal RCA skeleton and assign owners: eng-runtime to own technical RCA, eng-platform to own rollout gating policy change, eng-security + legal to own customer redaction and forensics, cs to own customer comms, finance to finalize credits.

cs-liz: scheduled private call with medcare security + engineering for 07:00 UTC (within 3 hours) and an exec call for tomorrow 09:00 PST as requested. Sending invite once legal approves the attendee list.

legal-marta: approved attendee list includes our forensics lead, eng-runtime-zoe, eng-security, cs-liz, and optionally CEO-james if requested. We'll handle regulatory notification guidance if PHI confirmed.

eng-platform-chen: adding pipeline guard: new validation will assert EMB_CACHE_NAMESPACE present for all sidecar deploys and fail the deployment if not. Also adding automated canary assertion that a fake-tenant key does not resolve to global cache during canary test.

sre-kyle: evidence upload complete: s3://inc-evidence/1806001234/{env_dumps,cache_key_samples,redacted_responses,node_snapshots}. Permissions set to sec-audit-only.

oncall-maya: marking live mitigation as complete at 05:12 UTC: traffic isolated, emergency toggle applied, env fix rolled, and 30m clean sample observed. Incident remains under investigation until forensics and RCA finish.

eng-runtime-zoe: committing to deliver 72-hour RCA draft. I'll include timeline, reproduced test harness, code diff for the sidecar fix (fail-closed + required env assertion), and suggested CI fuzz test for cache namespaces.

cs-liz: sent interim customer update at 05:14 UTC: acknowledged isolation and mitigation, committed to private forensics session and RCA timeline, offered provisional compensation and expedited review of their dedicated deployment settings. Medcare replied: "Appreciate the quick action. We need clear confirmation about PHI ASAP."

eng-security: action items for forensics: 1) enumerate redacted request IDs and minimal context to report, 2) perform HMAC audit of cache keys to determine scope, 3) identify timeline of global cache hits. Owner: eng-security.

finance-raj: finalize credit memo after legal confirms wording. Provisionally reserve $60k.

legal-marta: prepare formal non-disclosure and evidence exchange template for medcare, and a suggested exec-level statement draft for CEO review.

ceo-james: review the exec draft when ready. I'll join the executive call tomorrow 09:00 PST.

oncall-maya: final internal action checklist posted: RCA 72h (eng-runtime-zoe), rollouts policy change (eng-platform-chen), CI tests + canary gating (eng-runtime + eng-platform), forensics & redacted evidence (eng-security + legal-marta), customer comms + exec briefing (cs-liz + ceo-james), credits & finance (finance-raj).

eng-runtime-zoe: adding long-term backlog items: replace env-config reliance with immutable sidecar image build-time namespace injection, add end-to-end multi-tenant canary harness, and require unit/integration tests for fail-closed defaults.

cs-liz: medcare accepted our invite for the 07:00 UTC forensics session. They asked for a written RCA within 48h and a full forensics pack in 14 days. We committed to those timelines.

oncall-maya: closing live incident loop. Incident severity remains P1 until RCA but mitigation stage is complete. Thanks to all responders. :heart:
